"import csv
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

# Read CSV
csv_path = 'perf_06.csv'
rows = []
with open(csv_path, 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        rows.append(r)

# Compute statistics
cl_max_vals = [float(r['cl_max']) for r in rows]
cd_cruise_vals = [float(r['cd_cruise']) for r in rows]
ld_vals = [float(r['ld_ratio']) for r in rows]

cl_max_max = max(cl_max_vals)
cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise_vals) / len(cd_cruise_vals)
ld_mean = sum(ld_vals) / len(ld_vals)

# Find best config (max L/D)
best_idx = ld_vals.index(max(ld_vals))
best_config = rows[best_idx]['config']

# Round display values
cl_max_max_disp = round(cl_max_max, 3)
cd_cruise_mean_disp = round(cd_cruise_mean, 4)
ld_mean_disp = round(ld_mean, 1)

# Create presentation
prs = Presentation()

# Slide 1: Title
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
title = slide1.shapes.title
subtitle = slide1.placeholders[1]
title.text = "Performance Data Report"
subtitle.text = "Aerodynamic Analysis Summary"

# Slide 2: Data
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide2.shapes.title.text = "Data"

headers = ['config', 'cl_max', 'cd_cruise', 'ld_ratio']
n_rows = len(rows) + 1
n_cols = len(headers)

table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(9), Inches(5))
table = table_shape.table

# Header row
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = table.cell(0, i)
    cell.text = h

# Data rows
for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
    for ci, h in enumerate(headers):
        cell = table.cell(ri + 1, ci)
        cell.text = str(row[h])

# Slide 3: Summary
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide3.shapes.title.text = "Summary"

body = slide3.shapes.placeholders[1]
tf = body.text_frame
tf.text = f"CLmax max = {cl_max_max_disp}"
p = tf.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_mean_disp}"
p = tf.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_disp}"
p = tf.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"best config (max L/D) = {best_config}"

# Slide 4: Next steps
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide4.shapes.title.text = "Next Steps"
body4 = slide4.shapes.placeholders[1]
tf4 = body4.text_frame
tf4.text = "Review aerodynamic data, validate test points, and proceed with design refinement."

prs.save('report.pptx')"
